steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each engagement is placed by its margin against the floor, and each cost by its engagement.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 engagement is below the margin floor

findings.title: Fee differs from the billing
findings.fix: Reconcile the fee to the billing

findings.title: Cost with no engagement
findings.fix: Attach the cost to an engagement

outcome.notChecked: Whether the fee is fair to the client.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] eng-brightline.csv:12  Engagement below the margin floor.
       Fix: Re-price or re-scope the engagement.
[medium] billing-extract.csv:19  Fee differs from the billing.
       Fix: Reconcile the fee to the billing.
[low] cost-lines.csv:26  Cost with no engagement.
       Fix: Attach the cost to an engagement.
Not checked: Whether the fee is fair to the client.
pros: Checks an engagement below the margin floor, a fee that differs from the billing, and a cost with no engagement.
cons: Not checked: Whether the fee is fair to the client.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hrc-fee-margin-review skill on the records for this review.
